headline: AZB & Partners acts on Paras Hospitals ₹1,800 crore proposed IPO
sum: Paras Healthcare Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI for an initial public offering of equity shares comprising of a fresh issue and an offer for sale by selling shareholders, aggregating up to ₹1,300 crore. AZB &…
detail: Paras Healthcare Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI for an initial public offering of equity shares comprising of a fresh issue and an offer for sale by selling shareholders, aggregating up to ₹1,300 crore. AZB & Partners is advising Paras Hospitals, and the promoter selling shareholder Dr. Dharminder Kumar Nagar on this IPO. The transaction is led by Agnik Bhattacharyya (Senior Partner) and Sweta Ananthanarayanan (Partner), with support from Tanaiy Tewari (Senior Associate).
